results.comment: Tapped REQUEST LOCATION PERMISSION, observed the real Android dialog, and tapped Don’t allow. On return, status was exactly “BLOCKED: Location permission is required.” and rationale was “RATIONALE: true”. Visible controls: “REQUEST LOCATION PERMISSION”, “REFRESH PERMISSION STATE”, and “USE LOCATION FEATURE”.

results.comment: Tapped REQUEST LOCATION PERMISSION. Android displayed the location permission dialog, and Don’t allow was tapped. Back on the fixture, status was exactly “BLOCKED: Location permission is required.” and rationale was exactly “RATIONALE: false”. Visible controls: REQUEST LOCATION PERMISSION, REFRESH PERMISSION STATE, and USE LOCATION FEATURE.
results.action: Tap Request location permission a second time. If Android displays a permission dialog, tap Don't allow. Return to the fixture and record the exact status, RATIONALE value, and visible controls.

results.comment: Observed status: "BLOCKED: Location permission is required." RATIONALE value: false. "Continue without location" and "Open app Settings" were both not visible.
results.action: Inspect and record the exact status, RATIONALE value, and whether Continue without location and Open app Settings are visible.

results.comment: Refresh changed the status from "BLOCKED: Location permission is required." to "GRANTED: Location feature is available." After Use location feature was tapped, the exact status was "GRANTED: Location feature used successfully." The final layout returned normally with the fixture title and all three buttons present, confirming it remained responsive.
results.action: Tap Refresh permission state, then tap Use location feature. Record the exact status and confirm the fixture remains responsive.

results.comment: Refresh was dispatched at resource-id refresh_permission_state. The exact refreshed status was "NOT_REQUESTED: Location is optional." with "RATIONALE: false". Use location feature was then dispatched at resource-id use_location_feature. Immediately afterward, the emulator showed the Android launcher rather than the fixture, so the fixture did not remain responsive/present.
